entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Our goal is to change Nakanohara's[n]heart, right? Let's go back to that place[n]from earlier.

entries.en: Dude, the hell is this? It's all wavy[n]and shit.

entries.en: Of course they are. We're in the subway,[n]you know.

entries.en: Yeah, but I thought this was a Palace!
entries.uk: Так, але я думала, це Палац!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then maybe this is how the public[n]views this place? I don't know.
entries.uk: То, може, саме таким це місце[n]бачать люди? Не знаю.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People go through this darkness...[n]every day?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Forget that! You sure we're cool runnin'[n]around on these tracks!?
entries.uk: Та забудь! Ти певен, що нам можна[n]бігати по цих коліях!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It should be fine as long as we're not[n]on the same ones... I think. I'm no[n]train expert.
entries.uk: Має бути гаразд, якщо ми не на тих[n]самих... Мабуть. Я не знавець[n]поїздів.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You gotta be kiddin' me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, let's head to the lower area.[n]It should be right after we go down[n]that escalator.
entries.uk: Хай там як, спускаймося в нижню зону.[n]Вона має бути одразу за тим[n]ескалатором.

entries.en: Joker, we haven't met up with Jose yet.
